_why: Tokens `@theme` defines on purpose and src/ does not paint yet — each line names the ruling that reserves it, which is what makes the reservation a decision rather than an orphan nobody wrote down (MS36, GAP-ANALYSIS §2 rank 10; the corpus contract is `atlassian/tokens-governance-versioning.md#A18-gov-02`, a closed set, and `spectrum/tokens-governance-versioning.md#S18-token-08`, a component-specific set with the refusal stated). `check:token-usage` fails an entry that no `@theme` block declares (allowlist-entry-absent) and an entry a page now paints (allowlist-entry-written), so this file cannot quietly drift into a lie. An empty list would mean every unused token is reported as a defect, which is D253's discipline applied from the other side.

allow.why: D105 — the elevation pair is solved maths (the contact edge clears the 1.35 layer bar at .165 ink instead of black). Nothing floats in src/: GAP §5 keeps `DRAFT·state-layer-overlay` and there is no modal or dropdown, so the pair ships defined-but-unused until the first menu. Deleting the values is the work of re-deriving them.

D105 — same pair, the higher stop. src/components/Navigation.astro names `shadow-e2` in a comment about a floating menu, which is a mention and not a paint; the gate counts a comment as prose (the same class as `check:reduced-motion`'s guard-in-a-comment strip).

MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' / 'Buttons and chips' — the chip track. The chip row now states the construction is reserved rather than shipped, because 0 components paint a chip; the tints measure 1.02-1.13 against paper, under the 1.35 layer bar, so a track is never the only cue and the hue keyline plus the word carry the chip (D-round2).

MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' / 'Buttons and chips' — the chip track for the Meetup path. Reserved for the same reason as `color-path-calendar-tint`: the join paths carry their hue as a word today (`Footer.astro` paints `text-path-meetup-on-ink`), and the painted chip has never shipped.
MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' / 'Buttons and chips' — the chip track for the Discord path, reserved for the same reason: hue keyline + word carry a chip, and no component paints a chip yet.

MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' — the Mobilizon chip track. Mobilizon is the club's own platform (content.json harvests its feed and publishes it as /events.ics), and no surface paints its hue yet; the row is reserved until the operator's product letter says a Mobilizon door exists.

MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' — the band variant of the calendar hue. `check:contrast` already proved the paper set measures ~2.1 on the ink band, so the band needs its own lightness (L 64); the on-ink set is reserved until a chip sits on the band, which `check:ground`'s no-straddle rule (D149-3c) has to price first.
MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Join-path hues' — the band variant of the Mobilizon hue, reserved with the rest of the on-ink set for the chip that has never shipped.

MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Buttons and chips' — the chip keyline for the calendar path. `git log --all -S 'inset-shadow-path-'` returns only the token block and a prose round, so the ring never shipped in a component; the row that declared it is now corrected to say reserved, and the machinery stays defined because inverting it (D98: keylines are inset shadows, a border adds 2px and breaks control-height arithmetic) is the work of re-deriving it.
MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Buttons and chips' — the same chip keyline machinery, for the Meetup path. Never painted; reserved beside the row that says so.
MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Buttons and chips' — the same chip keyline machinery, for the Discord path.
MS36 + DESIGN.md 'Buttons and chips' — the same chip keyline machinery, for the Mobilizon path.

D95 — the type ramp is ratified as a nine-step 1.200 ladder, so the top step is part of the ladder whether or not a screen paints it; DESIGN.md keeps display at one step per screen. Its only src/ occurrence is a comment in src/components/HeroSection.astro naming the step, which the gate reads as prose. Reserved as a ramp step, not as a component-specific token.
D95 — the companion leading of `text-display-4`; the ramp is ratified as pairs, so the reservation moves with the step.
